name: Lunar south-polar ops-adjacent reference (Shackleton rim vicinity)
rationale: Hardware-test fingerprint for barren polar terrain and PSR-adjacent ops. Earth cannot match vacuum, illumination geometry, or ~40 K cold traps — those belong in the gap report.

slope_roughness.source: Pending: compute from LRO LOLA polar DEM at 20 m baseline (same baseline as Earth + Jezero)
slope_roughness.notes: Do not quote ~30° Shackleton wall averages from a garbled PDF table until checked against the paper. Leave null until the DEM script runs.

diurnal_temp_range.source: Diviner — no single citable diurnal ΔT used yet for this PSR-adjacent ref
diurnal_temp_range.notes: Polar thermal regime is illumination-driven, not Earth-like day/night. PSR floors reach ~40 K (Diviner cold-trap context; Paige et al., Science 2010). No Earth surface reaches that — hard gap. Prefer surface brightness temperatures when comparing to Earth LST; do not fake a ΔT.

precipitation.notes: Earth side uses aridity / precip ≈ 0 as a barren-surface proxy only.

mineralogy.source: No citable site mineralogy locked — feature zero-weighted / excluded while null
mineralogy.notes: Dropped until a cited highland/anorthositic affinity exists. Scoring already skips null targets.

ice_permafrost.source: Diviner PSR cold-trap relevance (Paige et al., Science 2010, doi:10.1126/science.1187726)
ice_permafrost.notes: Proxy for ice-stability relevance near PSRs — not a claim that Earth ice equals PSR ice.

name: Mars Jezero crater (Perseverance / MEDA)
rationale: Concrete rover-site fingerprint for thermal cycling + mobility rehearsal. Landing site of Perseverance; near-surface air temperatures from MEDA.

slope_roughness.source: Pending: compute from USGS Jezero 20 m elevation model at 20 m baseline
slope_roughness.notes: Same 20 m baseline as lunar polar DEM and Earth DEMs. Leave null until scripted.

diurnal_temp_range.source: MEDA air temperature diurnal amplitude ~60 K at 1.45 m (Munguira et al.; Perseverance MEDA)
diurnal_temp_range.notes: THIS IS AIR TEMPERATURE. Earth POWER T2M is also air — compare air↔air. Do not mix with MODIS land-surface temperature without labeling. Surface (TIRS) diurnal ranges are larger (surface max/min span can exceed air).

precipitation.notes: Earth aridity proxy via NASA POWER PRECTOTCORR.

mineralogy.source: Pending CRISM/EMIT-style cite for Jezero unit affinity
mineralogy.notes: Null until cited. EMIT on Earth analogs later.

ice_permafrost.source: Mid-latitude Jezero — not an ice-sheet analog (proxy low)
ice_permafrost.notes: Odyssey neutron products for ice-focused sites later; low weight for this arid/thermal use case.
